summary: Built a three-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9), running as systemd services with static bootstrap (initial-cluster listing all three peer URLs on port 2380, client traffic on 2379), SELinux context set for the binaries, and firewalld opened for 2379/2380. Verified a key written on node1 is readable from node2 and node3. Demonstrated availability during a member outage: stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read a new key via node1/node2 while node3 was down, then restarted node3 and confirmed it caught up on the missed key with matching raft-applied-index across all members. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id and etcd/data health before each reboot, triggered a native `reboot`, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified etcd/cluster quorum/stored keys were healthy before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Installed etcd/etcdctl v3.5.17 binaries on node1, node2, node3 from the official GitHub release tarball
Created etcd system user, /var/lib/etcd data dir, SELinux bin_t context for the binaries
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 on all three nodes
Created and enabled systemd unit etcd.service on each node with static 3-member initial-cluster configuration
Started the etcd cluster and verified 3/3 members healthy via member list / endpoint health
Wrote a key on node1 and confirmed it was readable on node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3, wrote/read a key via node1/node2 during the outage to prove continued read/write availability
Restarted etcd on node3 and confirmed it caught up on the outage-period key with raft-applied-index matching the other members
Captured pre-restart boot_id and etcd/data health baseline on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 via native `reboot`, one at a time, preserving quorum
Polled each node until reachable again and confirmed its boot_id changed, proving an actual OS restart occurred

After each restart, verified etcd active, cluster quorum healthy, member list correct, and both test keys (baseline-key, during-outage) still present and consistent across all endpoints before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: Three-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: systemd units created on all three nodes with matching static initial-cluster config; etcd started (node1 needed one extra poll due to startup ordering) and member list / endpoint health show all 3 members 'started' and healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written on one member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: baseline-key written via node1's endpoint, then successfully read back via node2's and node3's own client endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3's etcd stopped; a new key 'during-outage' was written via node1 and successfully read via node2 while node3 remained down, proving quorum-preserving availability

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member catches up when it returns
evidence.summary: node3's etcd restarted; it returned the 'during-outage' key written while it was down, and endpoint status shows raft applied index 18 identical across all three members, confirming full resync

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for all nodes (node-restart protocol step 1)
evidence.summary: boot_id and etcd active status plus successful reads of both test keys captured on node1, node2, and node3 prior to any OS reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed from e31962a9... to 6b6b72c7...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, raft applied index 22 synced, both test keys present

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; connection timed out mid-reboot; boot_id changed from 54bd1c3e... to b9014cec...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, raft applied index 27 synced (new leader elected on node3), both test keys present

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, full cluster health after last node
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; connection reset mid-reboot; boot_id changed from 4a743885... to 2ce831ba...; post-restart etcd active, 3/3 endpoints healthy, member list shows all 3 members started, raft applied index 32 synced across all members, both test keys present
